title: Kalaripayattu (Ancient Science of Martial Arts)
significance: One of the oldest fighting systems in the world, incorporating 108 Marma pressure points, ayurvedic oil body conditioning, and flexible swords (Urumi).

title: Koodiyattam (Sanskrit Temple Theatre)
roots: Natyashastra by Bharata Muni (2000+ years old)
significance: UNESCO Masterpiece of Oral & Intangible Heritage of Humanity, stylized eye gesture acting (Netranabhinaya).

title: Tradition of Vedic Chanting
significance: UNESCO Recognized master oral recitation tradition with strict phonetic precision (Svara, Matra, Balam) preserved unchanged for 3,500+ years.
